text.title: 盐晶体的一段影片
text.situation:
下一场演示是录制影片。沙不溶于水，演示者用过滤器将沙与盐溶液分离。水开始蒸发，稍后的特写显示晶体。字幕说明在适合条件下盐能结晶。展台另一部分比较浓有色溶液和稀溶液。屏幕旁的干果样本展示使材料脱水的含义。乔看了两次影片，区分分离过程和浓度变化。

乔：过滤器除去了溶解的盐吗？
工作人员：这场演示中，它分离了不溶的沙。
玛雅：那水呢？
工作人员：看影片下一段，水会蒸发。

paragraphs.en: The next demonstration was a recorded film. Sand was insoluble in the water, so the demonstrator used a filter to separate it from the salt solution. The water began to evaporate, and a later close-up showed a crystal. A caption explained that salt can crystallize as suitable conditions develop. Another part of the display compared a concentrated coloured solution with a dilute one. Beside the screen, a dried fruit sample illustrated what it means to dehydrate a material. Jo watched the film twice, keeping the separation process apart from the change in concentration.

paragraphs.en:
Jo: Did the filter remove the dissolved salt?
Attendant: In this demonstration it separated the insoluble sand.
Maya: And the water?
Attendant: Watch the next part of the film; it evaporates.
